citations.title: Take a Look Inside the Scandit Vision AI Engine
excerpts: Our [barcode scanning](https://www.scandit.com/products/barcode-scanning/) products share a unified codebase and common machine learning models. [ID scanning](https://www.scandit.com/products/id-scanning/) and [ShelfView](https://www.scandit.com/products/shelfview/) are technically distinct — but they're built by the same team, draw on the same deep expertise, and follow the same principles.
[Christian Floerkemeier](https://www.scandit.com/authors/christian-floerkemeier/) VP Product, CTO & Co-Founder

citations.title: How the Scandit Vision AI Engine Makes Shelf Technology Smarter
excerpts: [Christian Floerkemeier](https://www.scandit.com/authors/christian-floerkemeier/) VP Product, CTO & Co-Founder
**Reducing alert false positives:** After the ShelfView pipeline generates a potential alert, it doublechecks it using a vision language model (VLM).

**Supporting any hardware:** The core AI work happens in the cloud. This physical separation between capture and analysis allows retailers to use lower-end hardware and upgrade their devices without impacting how ShelfView operates.

basis.reasoning: The first post describes the product's unified codebase and shared ML models. The second explains cloud-processing architecture and VLM validation. Both identify the CTO and co-founder as author, satisfying the two technical-post requirement; classifying their content as engineering requires some judgment.
